## A whole world,pinnedfor you.

From sea caves to mountain peaks, PinIt is the map your wanderlust deserves. Crowdsourced by real explorers, no tourist traps in sight.

[![A serene cave with still water](https://pinitmap.net/images/home/bento-volcano-2.jpg)\\
\\
Discover\\
\\
**Hidden gems,  found by humans.** \\
\\
Every pin on PinIt was placed by someone who'd been there. Real coords, real photos, real tips. Not what an algorithm thinks you should see.](https://pinitmap.net/explore)

### Share your finds.

Drop a pin, add photos, write the kind of tip you wish you'd had before you went.

### Save for later.

Build trip lists, organise by region, and turn endless scrolling into actual itineraries.

### One map. The whole world.

Smooth pan-and-zoom across continents, with cluster-aware pins that always stay readable.

## The world,in your pocket.

PinIt is available on iOS and Android. Discover hidden gems, save your favourites, and plan your next adventure, wherever you are.

![Scan to download PinIt](https://pinitmap.net/icons/mobile-qr-code.png)

Scan to download

[![Download on the App Store](https://pinitmap.net/icons/apple-app-store.svg)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pinit-find-hidden-gems/id6775428851)[![Get it on Google Play](https://pinitmap.net/icons/google-play-store.svg)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.pinitmap.app)

Our belief

## Hidden gems belong  to everyone.

Most platforms think access to hidden gems is worth a monthly fee. We were built on the belief that it isn't. Open access isn't something we added, it's the reason PinIt exists.

[Our story](https://pinitmap.net/about)

Other apps

PinIt

Pay a subscription to unlock locations

Every location, always free

The same busy tourist hotspots

Off-the-map gems you won't find elsewhere

Vague directions, if it's even listed

Exact coordinates, photos and tips

![](https://pinitmap.net/images/plus/plus-upsell-hero.jpg)

PINIT PLUS

## For the explorers  who goa bit further.

More lists, deeper filters, and live weather at every pin. For the explorers who want to get the most out of every trip.

Advanced filters

Find exactly what you're looking for with enhanced precision.

Weather at every pin

See a 7-day forecast with hourly breakdown so you never get caught out.

Up to 100 lists

Free users get 5. Plus gives you 100, so you can plan every trip, region, and wishlist.

[See what's included](https://pinitmap.net/plus)

![PinIt Plus advanced filters interface](https://pinitmap.net/images/plus/plus-filters.png)

![PinIt Plus weather insights](https://pinitmap.net/images/plus/plus-weather-insights.png)
